mapper.select: select s.session_id as sessionId, case when s.buyer_id = #{userId} then s.seller_id else s.buyer_id end as peerUserId, u.user_name as peerUserName, u.img as peerUserImg, m.content as lastMessage, m.create_time as lastMessageTime, s.good_id as goodId, g.cart_title as goodTitle, (select count(1) from tb_chat_message cm where cm.session_id = s.session_id and cm.receiver_id = #{userId} and cm.is_read = 0) as unreadCount from tb_chat_session s left join tb_user u on u.user_id = case when s.buyer_id = #{userId} then s.seller_id else s.buyer_id end left join tb_goods g on g.second_hand_id = s.good_id left join tb_chat_message m on m.message_id = (select mm.message_id from tb_chat_message mm where mm.session_id = s.session_id order by mm.message_id desc limit 1) where s.buyer_id = #{userId} or s.seller_id = #{userId} order by ifnull(m.create_time, s.update_time) desc
